judgment.quote_A: The extra space complexity is O(n/2) or O(n), since the stack can grow to half the size of the input string in the worst-case scenario (if the input string consists of only alternating opening and closing parentheses).
judgment.quote_B: The space complexity is O(n) as well, because the maximum size of the stack is equal to the length of the longest unbalanced sequence of parentheses
judgment.reason: Both answers provide the correct stack-based function and O(n) time complexity but omit the required tests for 'a(b)c', ')(', and '(()', and both are truncated due to length limits. Answer A incorrectly claims the worst-case stack size occurs with alternating parentheses (which actually keeps the stack small), while Answer B correctly identifies the worst case as an unbalanced sequence of opening parentheses.
